title: Performance Work
meta: We find and fix slow pages, database queries and background jobs in your app. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Performance work for slow pages, queries and jobs
overview: We measure first. Using your logs, a profiler and real user paths, we find the slowest pages, queries and background jobs, then fix the worst offenders: missing indexes, repeated queries, heavy payloads and blocking tasks. You get before and after timings for each change, so you can see what improved. Anything too big for the sprint goes into a ranked list for later.

pkgs.blurb: Find the biggest slowdowns and fix the top few.
list: Measurement of up to 5 slow pages

Deep tuning across front end, database and background jobs.
list: Load test on up to 3 flows

faq: Can you promise a specific speed-up?
No. Results depend on what is slowing the app down. We show before and after timings for every change so you can judge. The first measurement tells us how much room there is.
Read-only access to logs and monitoring is usually enough. We test fixes on staging first. If we need production data, we ask for a copy with personal details removed.
Often, yes, by adding indexes or rewriting a query. Every change is a reviewed migration with a rollback, and we test it on a copy before it touches live data.
Node, Python, PHP and Ruby back ends with Postgres, MySQL or MongoDB, and React or Next.js front ends. If your stack is unusual, tell us and we confirm before you order.
